column1: Eligibility for Purchase by Money Market Funds
column3: The class A-1 notes have been structured to be “eligible securities” as defined in paragraph (a)(11) of Rule 2a-7 under the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended. Rule 2a-7 includes additional criteria for investments by money market  funds, including requirements relating to portfolio maturity, liquidity and risk diversification. A money market fund should consult its legal advisers regarding the eligibility of the class A-1 notes under Rule 2a-7 and whether an investment  in the class A-1 notes satisfies the fund’s investment policies, ratings requirements and objectives.
